# OmniSift

OmniSift, also known as 知漏, is an iOS AI knowledge capture app. It lets users save text, links, articles, and screenshots from any app through the iOS Share Sheet, then turns those snippets into structured knowledge cards.

## Core pages

- Product: https://huangweijun.github.io/omnisift/
- Use cases: https://huangweijun.github.io/omnisift/use-cases.html
- Comparison: https://huangweijun.github.io/omnisift/compare.html
- FAQ: https://huangweijun.github.io/omnisift/faq.html
- Changelog: https://huangweijun.github.io/omnisift/changelog.html
- Privacy: https://huangweijun.github.io/omnisift/privacy-policy.html
- App Store: pending review, URL not public yet

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS
- Category: Productivity / Reference
- Input types: text, links, articles, screenshots
- Capture entrypoint: iOS Share Sheet
- Output: title, summary, highlights, tags, named entities, semantic relations, related insights, knowledge graph connections
- Account requirement: no account required
- Analytics and tracking: no analytics services, advertising frameworks, or tracking technologies
- Storage: processed knowledge cards are stored locally on device
- Cloud processing: text explicitly shared to OmniSift is sent to cloud AI for processing only
- Cloud AI service listed in privacy policy: zaimaai.cn
- Subscription handling: Apple App Store payment system via RevenueCat

## Pricing

- Free: 5 AI processing uses per day
- OmniSift Pro: 50 AI processing uses per day
- Public first-release price: ¥12/month or ¥68/year

## Short description

OmniSift is for people who find useful ideas in ChatGPT, Claude, Safari, Notes, WeChat, X, screenshots, and other iOS apps. Instead of manually copying snippets into a note app, they can share the content to OmniSift and receive a structured knowledge card.

## Chinese description

知漏是一款 iOS AI 知识捕获应用。用户可以通过系统分享菜单，从任意 App 保存文本、链接、文章和截图；知漏会将这些碎片整理成包含摘要、高亮、标签、实体和知识图谱关联的结构化知识卡片。卡片保存在设备本地，无需注册账号。
